content:
The audit report generation failed because the Word summary document did not include the required high-priority facility-session combinations.
The process successfully passed 5 tests but failed 'test_word_summary_content' with an AssertionError: 'Word summary must mention at least two high-priority facility-session combinations'. The verifier found that 'mentioned' was 0, failing the 'assert mentioned >= 2' check in /tests/test_outputs.py. While the script likely populated RawData and Formatted Data, it failed to correctly identify and write the top-priority facility-session strings (e.g., 'FAC-SESS' format) into the final OUTPUT_DOCX file.
